title: Topspin Drive Off Bounce (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 138bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ball lands short, bounces up to waist
Topspin drive off the bounce, no haste

[Verse 1]
Ball pitches short inside the transition zone
Rock back, load the paddle at the bone
Low to high swing path, brush the back
Topspin drive off bounce, stay on track

Contact at waist height, paddle low to high
Four to eight o clock swing path, watch it fly
Heavy topspin drops the ball back down
Topspin drive off bounce, holds its ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Low to high, four to eight
Brush the back, topspin creates
Contact waist, drive it through
Topspin drive, that is what you do

[Chorus]
Topspin drive off bounce, low to high
Brush the back, watch it fly
Four to eight the clock face shows
Topspin drive off bounce, there it goes

[Verse 2]
Why topspin off the short ball
Topspin brings the ball back down after all
Flat drive floats long over the back line
Topspin keeps the drive inside the nine

[Bridge]
Bluey: Magnificent topspin drive off the short ball, what technique
Trevor: The four to eight swing path generates optimal topspin for court-length drives
Michelle: Brush the back of the ball. Low to high. Let the spin do the work.

[Chorus]
Topspin drive off bounce, low to high
Brush the back, watch it fly
Four to eight the clock face shows
Topspin drive off bounce, there it goes

[Outro]
Low to high
Brush the back
Topspin drive off bounce
